title: PPT Master host capability declaration
description: Schema for skills/ppt-master/adapters/<host_id>/capabilities.json. One file per host; workflows consult this file instead of naming a host or its proprietary primitives directly (Constitution Principle VII). Delivered to skills/ppt-master/templates/schemas/host-capabilities.schema.json in Phase 1 implementation.

notes.description: Free-text documentation of a declared limitation and its fallback; required whenever any field above is 'unavailable', 'sequential-fallback', or false for a capability the happy path depends on.
